quality_highlights.aspect: Well-structured MCP server reference: quick-start -> transport options -> per-client setup -> Available Tools. Thorough parameter tables, clean deprecation guidance for run_id_or_url alias.
Single-field forbidden-field error is clean and professional: "field 'engine' cannot be used in shared workflows (only allowed in main workflows with 'on' trigger)".

single_file_improvements.issue: Line 71: multi-field forbidden-fields error uses %v on []string, producing bracket-wrapped unquoted output [field1 field2]. Inconsistent with single-field %s style and validateSharedWorkflowOnField strings.Join usage.
run-success message says 'All systems operational. This is a developing story.' - contradictory terminal-success vs in-progress language in same sentence.
